label: Order
caption: LINDSEY GRAHAM, UNITED STATES SENATOR V. FULTON COUNTY SPECIAL PURPOSE GRAND JURY
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the August 15, 2022 order of the United States District Court for the Northern District of Georgia, case No. 1:22-CV-03027, as modified by the district court’s September 1, 2022 order, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. Clarence Thomas Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States
